Package com.egradx.webservice.security

Class EgradxUserTokenContext

java.lang.Object
com.egradx.webservice.security.EgradxUserTokenContext
public class EgradxUserTokenContext extends Object
Represents the context of a user session or token, typically used for authorization logic and getting user's basic details. This object is generated by parsing a JWT (JSON Web Token) and contains user-related information, such as platform roles, scopes, session details, and token expiration. The class provides methods to check if a user has specific roles or scopes, and also provides the ability to check if the user's token is expired. It is used to manage and validate user information during the authorization process.

    • hasScope

      @Deprecated(forRemoval=false) public boolean hasScope(String scope)
      Deprecated.
      for a Human-typed token (the only kind egradx-auth's EgradxTokenIssuer issues), this will always decode to an empty set as of egradx-auth's move to per-request permission resolution — authorities are no longer baked into the token at all. Use EgradxPermissionResolver/EgradxTenantContext or @PreAuthorize("hasAuthority(...)") instead. Still meaningful for Guest-typed temporary tokens, which continue to populate this field.
      Checks if the provided scope exists in the user's scope.
      Parameters:
      scope - the scope to check against the scope
      Returns:
      true if the scope is found in the scope, otherwise false

    • isTokenExpired

      public boolean isTokenExpired()
      Determines whether the user's token has expired, by its exp claim.
      Returns:
      true if the token has an expiry and it is now or in the past; false if it is still valid or carries no expiry

    • isTokenExpired

      public boolean isTokenExpired(Instant now)
      Determines whether the token has expired at the given instant. A token expires at expiresAt exactly, as JWT's exp defines it.
      Parameters:
      now - the instant to check against
      Returns:
      true if the token has an expiry at or before now; false if it is still valid then or carries no expiry
